Name: Wild Flowers Reimagined
Author: jodose
Description:
This mod adds random flowers to grass tiles. Originally inspired by [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/14061]Aedenthorn Wild Flowers[/url]. 
This mod selects from the available flowers ﻿in the season and grows a flower based on the `WildflowerGrowChance` 

[size=5]Install[/size]
[list=1]
[*][url=https://smapi.io]Install the latest version of SMAPI[/url].
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1348]Install the latest version of SpaceCore (multiplayer requirement) [/url]﻿
[*]Download this mod and unzip it into [font=Courier New]Stardew Valley/Mods[/font].
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]

[size=5]How to use[/size]
Each day a random number of flowers will appear on grass patches. 

[size=4]Configuration[/size]
You can use the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] or edit the `config.json` file. These are the options:
[list]
[*]﻿[b]ModEnabled[/b]: controls if the mod is enabled or not
[*][b]WildflowerGrowChance[/b]: Controls the probability that a grass patch grows a flower. In the config file `0.123` is equal to `12.3%%`
[*][b]FlowerGrassConfig.UseScythe[/b]: If enabled the flowers will need to be harvested by scythe, otherwise they will be harvested by hand
[*][b]PreserveFlowersOnProbability0[/b]: If enabled it will preserve the flowers that have been disabled that were already planted.
[*][b]FlowerProbabilityMap[/b]: Configure this to allow modifications to the probability of the different flowers appearing each season. Using the Generic Mod Config Menu is [b]recommended [/b]to change this behavior[u] [b]after loading the save[/b][/u]. But if you want to modify the JSON file each entry is "flower id": 0..5
[*][b]CheckAllLocations[/b]: If this option is enabled it will try to add flowers on grass tiles in all locations, instead of the default Farm and greenhouses. This option is useful for expansions.
[*]KeepRegrowFlower: If this option is enabled the multi-yield flowers will be preserved on harvest by hand. By default, there are no multi-yield flowers, however [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20290]Cornucopia - More Flowers[/url] trellis flowers do behave this way. ﻿
[/list]

[size=5]Limitations[/size]
[list]
[*]The flowers don't count for Beehives to make Honey
[*]It doesn't include Forable Flowers ( [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Sweet_Pea]Sweet Pea[/url], [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Crocus]Crocus[/url] ) as they don't have a seed ID
[*]Right now Generic Mod config entries are only available in English, the I18n module is available, so feel free to contribute translations.
[*]Linux/macOS have not been tested, Let me know if they work!
[/list]

[size=5]Compatibility[/size]
[list]
[*]Works with Stardew Valley 1.6 on Windows.
[*]Works in single-player
[*]Works on multiplayer, it [b]requires [/b]SpaceCore
[*]It should work with any modded Flowers if they have seeds. 
[/list]


[size=4] Spacecore [/size]
If you cannot use SpaceCore and you *don't* need multiplayer
you can update the mod manifest and delete the dependency key. Like this (remember to update the version to the latest one )
[code] ﻿{
"Name": "Wild Flowers Reimagined",
"Author": "jpp",
"Version": "3.1.2",
"Description": "A newer version of WildFlowers",
"UniqueID": "jpp.WildFlowersReimagined",
"EntryDll": "WildFlowersReimagined.dll",
"MinimumApiVersion": "4.0.0",
"UpdateKeys": [ "Nexus:21498" ]
}
[/code]

[size=5]For mod authors[/size]
By default, it will load all modded flowers, if you require that some of your flowers must not be added, you can use Content Patcher and write to these locations.
[code]        ﻿{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Mods/jpp.WildFlowersReimagined/IgnoreList",
"TargetField": [ "Flowers"],
"Entries": {
"Cornucopia_Chrysanthemum": "Cornucopia_Chrysanthemum"
}
},
{
"Action": "EditData",
"Target": "Mods/jpp.WildFlowersReimagined/IgnoreList",
"TargetField": [ "Seeds"],
"Entries": {
"Cornucopia_IrisSeeds": "Cornucopia_IrisSeeds",
"Cornucopia_VioletSeeds": "Cornucopia_VioletSeeds"
}
},
[/code]
Writing to the Flowers will prevent all seeds of that flower from working in the case of multiple seeds.
